meta.note: Sample candidates bundled with the employer app so the ATS is populated before any job seeker has applied. Every row carries "seed": true and an id prefixed "seed-cand-", so the set can be imported into the MySQL candidates table and later removed with DELETE FROM candidates WHERE seed = 1. Skills and certificates come from the same role table that drives the job seeker app, so a candidate here scores correctly against a vacancy posted there.
